title: Function serializers: clear include/exclude only when the user function actually ran
answers: model_dump(exclude=...) ignored when model_serializer has when_used='json'
include/exclude dropped for model_serializer fallback in python mode
why does exclude not work with plain/wrap model_serializer when_used
field_serializer when_used fallback loses include exclude filtering
body:
Symptom: a model with `@model_serializer(mode='plain'|'wrap', when_used='json')` ignores `include`/`exclude` in `model_dump()` (python mode): all fields come back even though the custom serializer wasn't used.
Root cause: pydantic-core/src/serializers/type_serializers/function.rs:function_type_serializer (to_python, json_key, serde_serialize) always scoped the return serializer with `IncludeExclude::empty()`, assuming the user function had already done the filtering, even when `self.call` returned `(false, v)` (when_used didn't match) and the fallback serializer was used.
Fix pattern: return the include/exclude together with the chosen serializer: `(true, v)` -> `IncludeExclude::empty()` (the function filtered); `(false, v)` -> `state.include_exclude()` (new clone accessor on SerializationState in pydantic-core/src/serializers/extra.rs), then `state.scoped_include_exclude(include_exclude)`.
Constraints: apply the same branching in all three serializer paths (to_python, json_key, serde_serialize), or the modes will behave differently. When the function did run (json mode here), its output is still not filtered by include/exclude (test expects `{'ser': True}`). Regression test: tests/test_serialize.py:test_model_serializer_when_used_fallback_respects_include_exclude.
applies: pydantic-core function (plain/wrap) serializers with when_used conditions and include/exclude propagation
